events.headline: Ethiopian government forces retake Tigray capital Mekelle and its airport after TPLF-led rebel alliance withdraws, in the worst escalation of the conflict since the 2020-2022 civil war; African Union warns the renewed fighting threatens the 2022 Pretoria peace agreement

OPEC+ Joint Ministerial Monitoring Committee agreed Oct 4 to keep November production quotas unchanged, while Brent/WTI have firmed after President Trump ruled out easing Iran sanctions, keeping Gulf exports constrained

China's Ministry of Commerce confirmed its suspension of October-2025 rare-earth/lithium-battery export controls (agreed at the Trump-Xi summit) has been extended to January 10, 2027, averting a near-term supply shock but leaving the structural dispute over critical-mineral chokepoints unresolved

Semiconductor, memory and storage names rallied in Oct 5 trading (LRCX, AMAT, ARM, WDC, STX, SNDK all up) as TSMC raised its 2026 capex budget to $60-64B ahead of Oct 15 earnings, with global chip sales still tracking toward 26% YoY growth on AI/data-center demand

SEC proposed a new crypto-custody framework (Oct 1) letting registered investment advisers and funds custody crypto assets directly when no qualified custodian is available, the latest step in the agency's broader digital-asset rulemaking push

Fed hiked rates Sept 16 to 3.75%-4% in a unanimous 12-0 vote as Chair Warsh called inflation 'too high for too long' (PCE ~3.6%, driven partly by war-related energy costs); officials have flagged one more possible hike before year-end, with September FOMC minutes due this week
